name: fight_act1_dror_ragzlin_tactician
title: Act 1 boss: Dror Ragzlin's throne room (Tactician)
about: The Tactician variant of fight_act1_dror_ragzlin: the same fight from the same moment, the same goal and caps, with the game's difficulty at Tactician instead of Balanced (tougher enemies, a smarter enemy AI). Fight (family 1), a boss with a large crowd: the goblin warlord in the Shattered Sanctum's throne room and the goblins around him. claude-run-2 S018 killed him and 13 goblins with many downs, no reload.

start.needs_save: Act 1, fight_act1_dror_ragzlin's start moment: its start save Tav-5122126499__SCN-fight_act1_dror_ragzlin (lsv sha1 d8ab62ff9b79) loaded with BG3AI_SCENARIO_SETUP=1, the game's difficulty switched from Balanced to Tactician (game menu > Difficulty > Change Difficulty > Tactician > Confirm) and nothing else done: party level 3, companions (Wyll, Gale, Shadowheart). Avatar named Tav (a paladin, Oath of Devotion), Karmic Dice off, Tactician (the difficulty lives in the save), out of combat with no dialogue open, saved as SCN-<name> (docs/SCENARIOS-AUTHORING.md).

note.where: The Shattered Sanctum, at the throne room's door; the goblins are not hostile yet.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A level-headed half-elf paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant: protects the weak, keeps promises, distrusts mind magic and anyone who offers easy power.
